card.name: V at start of capitalized brand names
card.fires_on: The letter V that begins an all-caps brand drug name, right after words like of, starting, continue, discontinue or taking. It fires where the name is just beginning.

modes.label: Brand name after a verb
modes.description: V opens an uppercase drug name following a verb such as starting, continue, discontinue or taking.

modes.label: Brand name after 'of'
modes.description: V opens an uppercase drug or study name after 'of', as in initiation of or use of.
modes.example: In Study 1 of<< V>>IKTORIA-1, increased fasting

card.writes: It seems to push the model to continue the name with the rest of the brand letters, with little clear link to the listed tokens.
card.plain: It marks the first letter V of a capitalized brand drug name in a drug label.
